module: Mechanics controller (type "auxiliary") that converts the displacement of a sensor beam into pulley rotation: the length change since the start, divided by an effective radius, gives an angle; the fraction of a turn (0..1, modulo 1) is multiplied by a factor (360 by default) and written into an electrics value to animate a rotating part.
notes: jbeam keys (default): sensorBeamTag (required), effectiveRadius (m, required > 0), angularOutputElectricsName (required), angularOutputElectricsMultiplier (360).
The code's error messages mention "beamSegments" and "pulleyRadius" (copy-paste) even though they concern this controller.
Inconsistency: isActiveCoef and beamBroken serve no purpose (updateGFX does not check it); reset calls obj:getBeamLength(sensorBeamId) without checking that sensorBeamId exists.

updateGFX.desc: Defined at init if the configuration is valid.

init.desc: Finds the sensor beam and validates the configuration.

reset.desc: Stores the sensor's starting length and resets the output to 0.

updateGFX.desc: Writes the converted fraction of a turn into the output electrics value.

beamBroken.desc: Hook: called when a beam breaks; marks the controller inactive if it is the sensor (no real effect, see notes).
